kinds.description: Vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal an associated section of content. Supports single and multiple expansion modes.

keyboard.description: Move focus to next accordion header
Move focus to previous accordion header
Move focus to first accordion header
Move focus to last accordion header

kinds.description: Static alert banner for important messages. Uses role='alert' which provides implicit aria-live='assertive'. Supports info, success, warning, and error intents.

Modal alert dialog for confirmations and destructive actions. Uses native <dialog> element with role='alertdialog', aria-modal='true', and focus trap. Cancel button receives initial focus per APG safety pattern. ColdLight-owned ARIA.
Fixed aspect ratio container for media and content. Supports named presets and numeric ratios. No ARIA semantics.
User avatar with image and fallback support. Uses role='img' with aria-label for accessible name. Manages image load/error state internally.
Status indicator badge for labels, counts, and notifications. Uses role='status' for live-region semantics. Supports intent-driven coloring.
Full-width alert banner for important messages. Uses role='alert' for assertive live region. Supports dismiss via action slot. Intents: info, success, warning, error.
Generic layout container. Provides padding and border-radius via recipe. No ARIA semantics — purely structural.
Breadcrumb navigation showing the current page location in a hierarchy. Uses nav + ol with aria-current=page on the last item.
Interactive button element for triggering actions. Supports toggle (aria-pressed), loading (aria-busy), and disabled states.
Single-month calendar grid for date selection. ColdLight-owned ARIA with grid pattern, roving tabindex for day navigation, and keyboard month/year navigation.

keyboard.description: Move to same day previous week
Move to same day next week

kinds.description: Informational callout box with role='note'. Highlights supplementary content with semantic variants: info, success, warning, error, tip.
Semantic content container with header, body, and footer sections. Uses role=group with aria-labelledby for accessible card title association.
Centering container using flexbox. Centers children both horizontally and vertically. Supports inline variant.
Toggle control with tri-state support (checked, unchecked, indeterminate). Uses role='checkbox' with aria-checked for state.
Code display component. Renders as inline <code> or block <pre><code>. Provides syntax styling via recipe. Supports language hint via data attribute.
A disclosure widget that shows or hides associated content. The trigger toggles the visibility of the content section.
Color picker input with swatch preview and optional label. Uses native <input type='color'> for color selection.

Compound combobox with text input autocomplete, toggle trigger, floating listbox popup, selectable options with grouping support. MeltUI adapter provides ARIA, keyboard navigation, and focus management via aria-activedescendant. WAI-Adapt declares machine-readable action/purpose for AI agents.

keyboard.description: Open listbox or highlight next option
Open listbox or highlight previous option
Accept current value and move focus

kinds.description: Max-width responsive container. Centers content horizontally with responsive max-width breakpoints. No ARIA semantics.
Right-click triggered context menu with keyboard navigation and item selection. Uses role='menu' with role='menuitem' children. MeltUI spatialmenu adapter provides ARIA and focus management.

Enhanced data table with grid semantics for sorting, filtering, and selection. Uses role='grid' with aria-rowcount, aria-colcount for virtualized data sets. Supports aria-sort on column headers and aria-selected on rows.
Segmented date input with separate spinbutton segments for month, day, and year. ColdLight-owned ARIA with roving focus across segments and increment/decrement via arrow keys.
Combined date field and calendar popover for date selection. ColdLight-owned ARIA with popover dialog pattern, date-field spinbutton segments, and calendar grid.
Two segmented date fields for start/end range input. ColdLight-owned ARIA with spinbutton segments, roving focus across all segments, and range validation.
Combined date range field and range calendar popover for date range selection. ColdLight-owned ARIA with popover dialog, dual spinbutton field segments, and range calendar grid.
Semantic description list for term-detail pairs using <dl>, <dt>, and <dd> elements. Supports aria-label for accessible identification. Native HTML provides implicit semantics.
Modal dialog overlay for focused interaction. Uses native <dialog> element with role='dialog', aria-modal, and focus trap. ColdLight-owned ARIA — no MeltUI dependency.

Visual divider element using <hr>. Uses role='separator' with aria-orientation for semantic dividers, or role='none' with aria-hidden for purely decorative dividers. Alias for separator with identical behavior.
Disclosure-triggered menu with keyboard navigation, item selection, and nested groups. Uses role='menu' with role='menuitem' children. MeltUI spatialmenu adapter provides ARIA and focus management.

keyboard.description: Close menu and return focus to trigger

kinds.description: Empty content placeholder with role='status'. Displays icon, title, description, and action CTA when content areas have no data.
Flexbox layout container. Provides direction, wrap, gap, align, justify via recipe. No ARIA semantics — purely structural.
Native form container with submit/reset handling, pending state tracking, and disabled propagation. Implicit form role via <form> element.
Compound form field wrapper providing label, control, description, and error slots with automatic aria-describedby, aria-invalid, and aria-required linking.
CSS Grid layout container. Provides columns, gap, rows via recipe. No ARIA semantics — purely structural.
Semantic heading component (h1-h6). Builder sets role='heading' and aria-level. Visual size decoupled from semantic level.
Horizontal flex layout shorthand. Provides gap and alignment via recipe. No ARIA semantics — purely structural.
Inline feedback message with role='status' and aria-live='polite'. Used for form validation, help text, and contextual status messages. Tones: info, success, warning, error, help.
Text input field with validation states. Uses native <input> with implicit textbox role. Supports invalid, required, readonly, and disabled states via ARIA.
Container grouping for an input element with optional prefix and suffix addons. Uses role='group' to associate addons with input.
Keyboard shortcut indicator using semantic <kbd> HTML. Displays keyboard keys with keycap styling. No ARIA needed.
Native label element with for= attribute for associating with form controls. Provides disabled state styling hook.
Semantic HTML list for ordered or unordered items. Uses role='list' on root and native <li> items. Supports aria-label for accessible identification.
Full-area loading overlay with role='alert' and aria-busy. Covers content with a semi-transparent backdrop, spinner, and optional label. Hidden when not visible.

Horizontal menu bar containing multiple dropdown menus. Root has role='menubar', each trigger has role='menuitem' with aria-haspopup. Supports keyboard navigation between menus via ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and within menus via ArrowUp/ArrowDown.

keyboard.description: Open menu or move to next item

kinds.description: Navigation landmark element for grouping navigation links. Provides aria-label for multiple nav landmarks.
Navigation link item. Supports active (aria-current=page) and disabled states. Child of Nav.

Site navigation component with expandable sub-menus. Uses semantic HTML (nav, ul, li, a) with ColdLight-owned ARIA. Roving tabindex across top-level items, disclosure pattern for sub-menus. No MeltUI dependency.

keyboard.description: Open sub-menu or move into it

kinds.description: Notification center panel with role='log'. Uses aria-live='polite' and aria-relevant='additions' for accessible notification delivery. Supports open/close state via Escape key.
Numeric spinbutton input with increment/decrement controls. Supports min, max, step, disabled, readonly, and required states.
Page navigation component. Renders a nav landmark with page buttons, previous/next controls, and ellipsis indicators. Uses aria-current='page' for the active page.
Progress bar indicating completion status. Supports determinate (aria-valuenow) and indeterminate states. Uses role='progressbar' with required aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuenow.
Rich text content container with typographic styling. Markdown-friendly. Applies prose utilities for consistent text rendering.
Compound radio group component with roving tabindex and keyboard navigation. MeltUI adapter provides ARIA checked state and focus management.

keyboard.description: Move focus to next radio and select
Move focus to next radio and select
Move focus to previous radio and select
Move focus to previous radio and select

kinds.description: Date range selection calendar with start/end highlighting. ColdLight-owned ARIA with grid pattern, roving tabindex, and range state tracking for hover preview.

keyboard.description: Move to same day previous week
Move to same day next week

kinds.description: Custom scrollbar container with accessible viewport region, scrollbar track, and draggable thumb. Supports vertical and horizontal orientations.
Search input with search landmark, decorative icon, and clear button. Escape key clears value.
Compound select/listbox component with trigger button, dropdown content, selectable items, and optional label and groups. MeltUI adapter provides ARIA and keyboard navigation.

keyboard.description: Open listbox or move to next option
Open listbox or move to previous option

kinds.description: Semantic separator element using <hr>. Uses role='separator' with aria-orientation for content separation. Supports decorative mode with role='none' and aria-hidden='true'. Canonical separator primitive.
Slide-in panel overlay (side drawer). Supports left/right/top/bottom sides, focus trapping, Escape dismiss, and outside click close.
Side navigation panel with expand/collapse toggle. Contains header, content, and footer sub-slots with aria-expanded state management.
Animated loading placeholder with role='status' and aria-busy. Provides visual feedback while content loads. Variants: text, circular, rectangular.
Accessibility skip-to-content link. Visually hidden until focused. Moves focus to the target element on activation.
Compound slider component with track, range indicator, and draggable thumb. MeltUI adapter provides ARIA value attributes and keyboard navigation.
Presentational flex spacer element. Purely decorative — aria-hidden='true'. No children. Grows to fill available space by default.
Animated loading spinner with role='status'. Provides aria-label='Loading' by default. Becomes aria-hidden when not active.
Vertical flex layout shorthand. Provides gap and alignment via recipe. No ARIA semantics — purely structural.
Display statistic with role='group'. Contains label, value, and optional helptext slots. Grouped semantically via aria-label or aria-labelledby.
Step progression indicator for multi-step workflows. Tracks active step with aria-current, supports linear and non-linear navigation.
Position sticky wrapper for fixed-scroll elements. Provides top offset and z-index via recipe. No ARIA semantics.
On/off toggle switch. Uses role='switch' with aria-checked for binary state.
Semantic HTML table for tabular data display. Supports aria-label for accessible identification, aria-describedby for additional context, and aria-sort on head cells for sortable columns.
Navigation list of document headings. Tracks the currently visible heading with aria-current=location. Uses nav + ol structure.
Tabbed navigation with roving tabindex. Uses role='tablist', role='tab', role='tabpanel' with aria-selected and aria-controls/aria-labelledby linking. ColdLight-owned ARIA — no MeltUI dependency.

Typography text component. Renders as ,

, or other inline/block elements. Provides size, weight, and color via recipe.
Multi-line text input field. Supports validation (aria-invalid), required (aria-required), readonly (aria-readonly), and disabled states. Always aria-multiline=true.
A two-state toggle button. Uses role='button' with aria-pressed for binary on/off state.
Group of toggle buttons with single or multiple selection. Supports roving tabindex, arrow key navigation, and orientation.
Container for grouping related action controls. Supports horizontal/vertical orientation with roving tabindex keyboard navigation.
A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.
Utility component that visually hides content while keeping it accessible to screen readers. Uses the sr-only CSS pattern.

definitions.label: Bevel Subtle (CSS)
definitions.description: Minimal top-edge highlight via inset box-shadow. Baseline tier for subtle depth.

definitions.label: Bevel Soft (CSS)
definitions.description: Dual-edge inset shadows — top highlight + bottom shadow. Baseline tier.

definitions.label: Bevel Medium (CSS)
definitions.description: Pronounced dual-edge inset shadows with wider spread. Baseline tier.

definitions.label: Bevel Soft (SVG)
definitions.description: Specular lighting 3D edge. Premium tier — use on panels, modals, hero elements.

definitions.label: Bevel Medium (SVG)
definitions.description: Stronger specular 3D edge with pronounced ridge. Premium tier.

definitions.label: Bevel Strong (SVG)
definitions.description: Maximum specular depth with dual light sources. Premium tier — hero surfaces only.

definitions.label: Depth Float
definitions.description: Subtle elevation with minimal shadow. For cards and slightly raised elements.

definitions.label: Depth Raised
definitions.description: Mid-weight elevation with 3-layer shadow stack. For panels and interactive surfaces.

definitions.label: Depth Elevated
definitions.description: Strong elevation with 4-layer shadow stack. For dialogs and modals.

definitions.label: Depth Lifted
definitions.description: Maximum elevation with 5-layer shadow stack including upward ambient glow. For tooltips and floating elements.

definitions.label: Neumorphic Outset
definitions.description: Neumorphism outset style. Dual opposing shadows create extruded appearance.

definitions.label: Neumorphic Inset
definitions.description: Neumorphism inset style. Dual inset opposing shadows create pressed/recessed appearance.

definitions.label: Frame Bevel
definitions.description: Heavy decorative frame with teal-tinted border, inset specular highlights, and ambient glow. For hero sections and featured content.

definitions.label: Border Glow on Hover
definitions.description: Border color transitions to teal accent on hover. Subtle border illumination.

definitions.label: Border Emphasize on Hover
definitions.description: Border opacity increases on hover. From subtle to visible.

definitions.label: Focus Border Teal
definitions.description: Border turns teal on focus-visible. Clear focus indicator for form elements.

definitions.label: Focus Border Glow
definitions.description: Border gains teal glow on focus-visible. Combines border color + box-shadow.

definitions.label: Active Border Inset
definitions.description: Border becomes inset shadow on active. Neuromorphic pressed effect.

definitions.label: Glass Void
definitions.description: Dark glass surface with 85% opacity, strong blur, sharp specular highlights. The primary dark-mode material.

definitions.label: Glass Deep
definitions.description: Deeper glass surface with 75% opacity, tighter blur, medium bevel. For nested panels and overlays.

definitions.label: Glass Smoke
definitions.description: Semi-transparent smoke glass with 60% opacity, light surface, minimal bevel. For subtle overlays.

definitions.label: Glass Frost
definitions.description: Light frosted glass with 40% opacity, white-tinted background. For light-mode or accent panels.

definitions.label: Glow Teal
definitions.description: Teal-colored ambient glow (12px spread, 40% opacity). Primary accent illumination.

definitions.label: Glow Purple
definitions.description: Purple-colored ambient glow. Secondary accent illumination.

definitions.label: Glow Magenta
definitions.description: Magenta-colored ambient glow. Tertiary accent illumination.

definitions.label: Glow Ember
definitions.description: Ember-colored ambient glow. Warm accent illumination.

definitions.label: Glow Frost
definitions.description: Frost-colored ambient glow. Cool accent illumination.

definitions.label: Glow Cyber
definitions.description: Cyber-colored ambient glow. Neon blue illumination.

definitions.label: Glow Accent
definitions.description: Dynamic accent glow using the current --_accent CSS custom property. Color follows context.

definitions.label: Glow Track
definitions.description: Cursor-following radial gradient glow. Appears on hover at mouse position. Requires relative positioning on parent.

definitions.label: Hover Lift
definitions.description: Element lifts slightly on hover with subtle transform. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

definitions.label: Press Down
definitions.description: Element presses down on active state with scale + translate. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

definitions.label: Fade In
definitions.description: Element fades in and slides up when entering the viewport. Uses IntersectionObserver.

definitions.label: Pulse Glow
definitions.description: Slow pulsing glow animation for attention-drawing elements. 4s cycle.

definitions.label: Hover Brighten
definitions.description: Subtle brightness increase on hover. Uses filter: brightness() with fast transition.

definitions.label: Hover Dim
definitions.description: Subtle dimming on hover. Used for ghost/secondary buttons.

definitions.label: Hover Scale
definitions.description: Subtle scale increase on hover. 2% growth with spring easing.

definitions.label: Hover Opacity
definitions.description: Opacity increase on hover. For muted elements that brighten on interaction.

definitions.label: Focus Ring
definitions.description: Teal focus-visible ring with 2px offset. Standard accessible focus indicator.

definitions.label: Focus Glow
definitions.description: Teal glow ring on focus-visible. More dramatic than focus-ring.

definitions.label: Active Press
definitions.description: Scale-down and brightness decrease on active/press state.

definitions.label: Active Depress
definitions.description: Subtle inward press effect — translateY + reduced shadow. Neuromorphic button feel.

definitions.label: Full Interactive
definitions.description: Complete interactive effect: hover brighten + focus ring + active press. Standard button interaction.

filters.label: Bevel Soft
filters.description: Soft 3D edge highlight using specular lighting. Subtle machined-metal edge for panels and cards.

filters.label: Bevel Medium
filters.description: Medium-strength 3D edge with pronounced specular ridge. Machined panel look for modals and key surfaces.

filters.label: Bevel Strong
filters.description: Maximum 3D depth with dual-light specular. Primary top-left key light + bottom-right teal fill light. For hero panels and featured surfaces.

filters.label: Noise Subtle
filters.description: Fine grain texture overlay. Adds tactile materiality without obscuring content.

filters.label: Noise Medium
filters.description: Visible grain texture. Machined metal surface appearance for hero elements.

filters.label: SVG Glow Teal
filters.description: Teal gaussian glow that follows shape contours. Shape-aware alternative to CSS box-shadow glow.

filters.label: SVG Glow Purple
filters.description: Purple gaussian glow that follows shape contours.
